Container.Name: steam-workshop-archiver
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Steam Workshop archiver: list a game's Workshop (or a collection / item list), download it with SteamCMD or DepotDownloader, keep it updated on a schedule, and browse it offline.

Config.Name: Metadata
Config.Description: Database, metadata, cached images and SteamCMD. Put it on a cache/SSD pool.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID files are written as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID files are written as

Config.Name: Auth password
Config.Description: Optional HTTP Basic auth password for the whole UI and API (any username)

Config.Name: Steam Web API key
Config.Description: Optional. Lists items via the official API (beyond the 30,000-item browse limit). Can also be set in Settings.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Host header allowlist (DNS-rebinding protection). auto = IPs, localhost and LAN names; add your reverse-proxy domain, e.g. auto,archive.example.com
